verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a typed, model-agnostic SDK with built-in native support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Groq, Mistral, and more, plus OpenAI-compatible APIs, letting developers build agents directly against official provider SDKs with a consistent typed interface. Community confirms broad provider/streaming support and production use, though some report inconsistencies with certain provider integrations.
